summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥100/share (interim ¥56 + final ¥44) from prior forecast of ¥82/share (¥46 + ¥36). Payout ratio 55.5%. 18th consecutive year of dividend increases. Net profit revised upward ¥1,000M to ¥5,400M following faster-than-expected gains from equity investment portfolio reduction. Progressive dividend policy through FY3/30; consolidated payout ratio floor 40%+.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Consolidated Business Performance Forecasts for Q2 (Interim) and Full Year FY3/27, and Revision of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Sekisui Jushi revised upward its dividend forecast for FY3/27 (year ending 31 March 2027) by raising the annual dividend from ¥82/share (interim ¥46 + final ¥36) to ¥100/share (interim ¥56 + final ¥44). This represents the 18th consecutive year of dividend increases. The revision reflects an upward adjustment of consolidated net profit attributable to parent-company shareholders by ¥1,000 million (to ¥5,400 million) driven by faster-than-expected gains from the reduction of policy holdings in subsidiary shares as part of capital-efficiency improvements. The payout ratio remains 55.5%, aligned with the company's disclosed dividend policy. The company states it pursues progressive dividend growth through FY3/30 with a consolidated payout ratio floor of 40% or above, as part of its strategy to maximize shareholder value alongside organic growth investment.
